citation.dataset: MANC (Male Adult Nerve Cord) connectome, HHMI Janelia FlyEM Project Team with Google Research and MRC LMB Cambridge. neuPrint datasets manc:v1.0 / manc:v1.2.1 / manc:v1.2.3. https://www.janelia.org/project-team/flyem/manc-connectome
citation.paper_reconstruction: Takemura S-y, Hayworth KJ, Huang GB, Januszewski M, Lu Z, et al. A Connectome of the Male Drosophila Ventral Nerve Cord. eLife 13:RP97769 (2024). doi:10.7554/eLife.97769
citation.paper_annotation: Marin EC, Morris BJ, Stuerner T, Champion AS, Krzeminski D, et al. Systematic annotation of a complete adult male Drosophila nerve cord connectome reveals principles of functional organisation. eLife 13:RP97766 (2024). doi:10.7554/eLife.97766

Transforming descending input into behavior: The organization of premotor circuits in the Drosophila Male Adult Nerve Cord connectome. eLife 13:RP96084 (version of record 2026-07-20; reviewed preprint 2024). doi:10.7554/eLife.96084
citation.neuprint: Plaza SM, Clements J, Dolafi T, Umayam L, Neubarth NN, Scheffer LK, Berg S. neuPrint: An open access tool for EM connectomics. Front. Neuroinform. 16:896292 (2022). doi:10.3389/fninf.2022.896292

definitions.neuron: body listed in the neuroglancer segment_properties annotation snapshot of the requested version (the bodies neuPrint manc:v1.2.x exposes as annotated neurons). No proofreading status is published for v1.2.x; status, is_traced and neuprint_neuron_label are null.
definitions.synapse_count: number of T-bar->PSD pairs of the v1.2 partner table passing the count rule (see build_info.count_rule), recomputed by BrainIR; neuPrint manc:v1.2.x weights are not publicly exported.
definitions.synapse_count_hp: pairs passing the high-precision rule (see build_info.count_rule).
definitions.edge_neuropil: primary ROI of the POSTsynaptic point (roi_post of the partner table; ROI catalogue from manc:v1.0).
definitions.neuron_neuropils.n_pre: APPROXIMATION: the partner table carries no T-bar ROI, so a T-bar is assigned the primary ROI of its PSDs (counted once per ROI it reaches). n_post is exact.
definitions.nt_body_prediction: carried over from manc:v1.0 body-level predictions by body ID (same segmentation lineage).
definitions.nt_type_prediction: cell-type-level NT tag of the annotation snapshot (v1.2.3 only).
definitions.autapse: pre_id == post_id; retained and flagged, not dropped.
definitions.coordinates: 8 nm isotropic voxels in the MANC EM space.

count_rule.basis: inferred on manc:v1.0 (neuPrint weight/weightHP vs raw partner counts)

transformations.description: HTTPS ranged download from the public GCS bucket; bytes verified against server CRC32C (and MD5 where available); GCS generation pinned in brainir.sources.registry; SHA-256 recorded; raw files set read-only.

ROI catalogue taken from the manc:v1.0 neuPrint Meta (same ROI volumes); every roi_post value of the v1.2 partner table is checked to be a v1.0 primary ROI. n_post_total recomputed under the count rule; n_pre_total null (T-bar ROIs are not published for v1.2).

neuroglancer segment_properties snapshot of the requested annotation version parsed into one row per body (label/string/number properties + one column per tag prefix, camelCase prefixes normalised to snake_case); '~'/'None'/'TBD' placeholders -> null.
neurons = bodies listed in the annotation snapshot. No proofreading status exists for v1.2.x: status, is_traced and neuprint_neuron_label are null.

Connections recounted from the raw v1.2 T-bar->PSD partner table under the explicit count rule (build_info.count_rule, inferred on v1.0): synapse_count = pairs passing the rule, synapse_count_hp = pairs passing the high-precision rule; per-edge neuropil = roi_post (exact); per-neuron n_pre approximated by the ROI of a T-bar's PSDs (no T-bar ROI is published). Autapses kept and flagged.

Body-level NT predictions carried over from the manc:v1.0 property export by body ID (same segmentation lineage; neurons absent from v1.0 get null). Cell-type-level NT from the snapshot's celltypePredictedNt tag (v1.2.3 only). No consensus NT exists.

IDs, uniqueness, duplicates, referential integrity, edge values, type/schema conformance, annotation coverage, directionality (exact edge-sum conservation + biological polarity), graph statistics, provenance, cross-source agreement between independent official exports, synapse-level recomputation on a seeded random neuron sample.
Rows sorted by primary key, dictionaries normalised, Parquet (zstd level 3, 1M-row groups) -> byte-identical outputs for identical inputs and library versions (see uv.lock).

schema.name: source_id
schema.description: Dataset-native neuron ID (neuPrint bodyId). Stable only within this version.

schema.name: cell_type
schema.description: Primary cell type label from the source ('type').

schema.name: instance
schema.description: Source instance label (usually type + side, e.g. 'DNp01(GF)_R').

schema.name: hemilineage_truman
schema.description: Hemilineage in Truman (VNC/SEZ) nomenclature, e.g. '17A' ('trumanHl'). Parallel to, not exclusive of, hemilineage_ito_lee (SEZ/descending neurons often carry both).

schema.name: soma_side
schema.description: Side of the soma: L, R or M (midline).

schema.name: root_side
schema.description: Side of entry root (sensory/afferent neurons without soma in volume).

schema.name: soma_neuromere
schema.description: Neuromere containing the soma (e.g. T1, T2, T3, A1, CG).

schema.name: animal_sex
schema.description: Sex of the imaged animal (dataset-level fact).

schema.name: is_traced
schema.description: status == 'Traced' (statusLabel >= 'Leaves'). Null when the source build carries no proofreading status (MANC v1.2.x annotation snapshots).

schema.name: neuprint_neuron_label
schema.description: Body carries the neuPrint :Neuron label (neuPrint's own, broader node criterion). Null when the build was not made from a neuPrint export.

schema.name: n_downstream
schema.description: Outgoing synaptic connections (T-bar->PSD pairs) to ANY segment.

schema.name: n_upstream
schema.description: Incoming synaptic connections from ANY segment.

schema.name: n_downstream_to_neurons
schema.description: Outgoing connections whose partner is in this neuron table.

schema.name: n_upstream_from_neurons
schema.description: Incoming connections whose partner is in this neuron table.

schema.name: nt_consensus
schema.description: Source 'consensusNt' (recommended by the source): cell-type prediction (untyped bodies: body prediction), overridden by literature/expert labels, with model octopamine/serotonin calls set to 'unclear'. Mixes ML output with curation; not physiology.

schema.name: nt_body_prediction
schema.description: Neurotransmitter predicted from this body's T-bars.

schema.name: nt_body_n_tbars
schema.description: Number of T-bar predictions aggregated for this body.

schema.name: nt_type_prediction
schema.description: Neurotransmitter predicted by aggregating all bodies of the cell type.

schema.name: nt_type_n_tbars
schema.description: Number of T-bar predictions aggregated for the cell type.

schema.name: nt_literature_label
schema.description: Known neurotransmitter of the cell type from literature ('ground_truth' in source).

schema.name: group_id
schema.description: Source homolog group ID (bilateral/serial partners share a group).

schema.name: synapse_count
schema.description: Number of synaptic connections = T-bar->PSD pairs (polyadic synapses: one T-bar may contribute several pairs) with confidence >= threshold (neuPrint 'weight'). Anatomical, NOT a physiological strength.

schema.name: synapse_count_hp
schema.description: High-precision subset: pairs whose PSD confidence >= the HP threshold (0.7 for MaleCNS; neuPrint 'weightHP'). Boundary: confidences are stored as float32 and compared in float64, so a PSD stored as float32(0.7)=0.69999999 is excluded.

schema.name: dominant_neuropil
schema.description: Primary neuropil holding the most PSDs of this connection (ties: lexicographic).

schema.name: n_neuropils
schema.description: Number of distinct neuropils (incl. unassigned) the connection spans.

schema.name: synapse_count
schema.description: Synaptic connections of this pair located in this neuropil.

schema.name: n_pre
schema.description: T-bars of this neuron in this neuropil.

schema.name: n_post
schema.description: PSDs of this neuron in this neuropil.

schema.name: name
schema.description: ROI name as used by the source.

schema.name: parent
schema.description: Authoritative single parent (source roiInfo 'parent'; else first hierarchy parent).

schema.name: all_parents
schema.description: Every parent of the ROI in the hierarchy DAG.

schema.name: depth
schema.description: Minimum depth in the hierarchy (root = 0); null if absent.

schema.name: in_hierarchy
schema.description: ROI appears in the source hierarchy (some have statistics only).

schema.name: top_level_region
schema.description: Depth-1 ancestor (e.g. CentralBrain, Optic(L), CV, VNC).

schema.name: is_primary
schema.description: Member of the non-overlapping primary ROI partition.

schema.name: side
schema.description: Side parsed from the name suffix '(L)'/'(R)'; null if unpaired.

fail_and_warn_checks.description: Primary ROIs absent from the source roiHierarchy, and hierarchy names without roiInfo statistics. Known source inconsistency (stale hierarchy); roiInfo/primaryRois are taken as authoritative and hierarchy-only names are not included in the catalogue.
